import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF295C_ {

    private static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    private static int[][][] minMemo;
    private static int[][][][] countMemo;
    private static int maxWeight;
    private static int totalFifty, totalHundred;
    private static boolean[][][] inProgress;
    private static long[][] combCache;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        maxWeight = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (sc.nextInt() == 50) totalFifty++;
            else totalHundred++;
        }

        setupCombinationTable();
        setupMinMemo();
        int minSteps = findMinSteps(totalFifty, totalHundred, 0);
        if (minSteps > 100000) {
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        setupCountMemo(minSteps);
        System.out.println(minSteps);
        System.out.println(countSolutions(totalFifty, totalHundred, 0, minSteps));

        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }

    private static void setupCombinationTable() {
        combCache = new long[101][101];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(combCache[i], -1);
        }
    }

    private static void setupMinMemo() {
        minMemo = new int[2][101][101];
        inProgress = new boolean[2][101][101];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 100; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(minMemo[i][j], -1);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void setupCountMemo(int maxDepth) {
        countMemo = new int[2][101][101][maxDepth + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 100; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= maxDepth; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(countMemo[i][j][k], -1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static int findMinSteps(int fifty, int hundred, int side) {
        if (fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) return 0;
        if (fifty == totalFifty && hundred == totalHundred && side == 0) return 0;

        if (minMemo[side][fifty][hundred] != -1) return minMemo[side][fifty][hundred];
        if (inProgress[side][fifty][hundred]) return 1_000_000_000;
        inProgress[side][fifty][hundred] = true;

        int best = 1_000_000_000;
        for (int takeFifty = 0; takeFifty <= fifty; takeFifty++) {
            for (int takeHundred = 0; takeHundred <= hundred; takeHundred++) {
                if (takeFifty + takeHundred == 0) continue;
                int value = takeFifty * 50 + takeHundred * 100;
                if (value > maxWeight) continue;

                best = Math.min(best, 1 + findMinSteps(totalFifty - fifty + takeFifty, totalHundred - hundred + takeHundred, side ^ 1));
            }
        }

        return minMemo[side][fifty][hundred] = best;
    }

    private static int countSolutions(int fifty, int hundred, int side, int stepsRemaining) {
        if (stepsRemaining < 0) return 0;
        if (fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) return stepsRemaining == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (fifty == totalFifty && hundred == totalHundred && side == 0) return stepsRemaining == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (stepsRemaining == 0) return 0;

        if (countMemo[side][fifty][hundred][stepsRemaining] != -1) return countMemo[side][fifty][hundred][stepsRemaining];

        long total = 0;
        for (int takeFifty = 0; takeFifty <= fifty; takeFifty++) {
            for (int takeHundred = 0; takeHundred <= hundred; takeHundred++) {
                if (takeFifty + takeHundred == 0) continue;
                int value = takeFifty * 50 + takeHundred * 100;
                if (value > maxWeight) continue;

                long ways = (nCr(fifty, takeFifty) * nCr(hundred, takeHundred)) % MOD;
                int sub = countSolutions(totalFifty - fifty + takeFifty, totalHundred - hundred + takeHundred, side ^ 1, stepsRemaining - 1);
                total = (total + ways * sub) % MOD;
            }
        }

        return countMemo[side][fifty][hundred][stepsRemaining] = (int) total;
    }

    private static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if (r > n || r < 0) return 0;
        if (r == 0 || r == n) return 1;
        if (combCache[n][r] != -1) return combCache[n][r];
        if (r > n - r) r = n - r;
        return combCache[n][r] = (nCr(n - 1, r - 1) + nCr(n - 1, r)) % MOD;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public Scanner(InputStream in) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
        }

        public Scanner(String fileName) throws FileNotFoundException {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(fileName));
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            return reader.readLine();
        }

        public boolean ready() throws IOException {
            return reader.ready();
        }
    }
}
